name: Lime oil terpenes
description: Lime oil terpenes (CAS 68917-71-5 ) is a terpene fraction derived from lime essential oil, separated during the concentration or rectification of the crude oil. It functions primarily as a solvent and fragrance carrier across food, cosmetic, and industrial applications. In flavour and fragrance compounding, it acts as a diluent and carrier for citrus aroma compounds, helping formulators achieve consistent scent profiles in beverages, confectionery, and cleaning products. Personal care manufacturers incorporate it into perfumes, colognes, and rinse-off products where a fresh citrus note is required alongside solvent functionality. This versatility makes it a staple in the cosmetic industry. In printing and packaging, it serves as a bio-based solvent component in ink formulations, offering a renewable alternative to petroleum-derived carriers. This supports sustainability goals for modern industrial manufacturers. Food-grade applications include use as a processing solvent and flavouring adjunct in citrus-flavoured products. It is often evaluated against FCC standards to ensure safety and compliance in food production. Lime oil terpenes are supplied as a mobile liquid, typically in drum and IBC quantities suited to industrial procurement volumes. These formats ensure efficient handling and storage for large-scale operations. Food-grade and technical-grade designations are the most commonly encountered specifications in the market. Buyers should confirm purity and terpene composition profile with suppliers prior to sourcing for regulated applications. Ensuring grade compliance is essential for maintaining product integrity across different sectors.
